// Original Go table/test: Copyright 2009 The Go Authors. See Go-LICENSE.
// Authored controls are supplementary, not upstream table rows.
// Build only with Go 1.27.3; arguments: src/time/format_test.go and Loki params.go.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"math/big"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type selection struct {
	Name       string `json:"name"`
	Lines      [2]int `json:"lines"`
	SHA256     string `json:"sha256"`
	OriginalGo string `json:"original_go"`
}

type source struct {
	Repository string      `json:"repository"`
	Version    string      `json:"version,omitempty"`
	Revision   string      `json:"revision,omitempty"`
	Path       string      `json:"path"`
	SHA256     string      `json:"sha256"`
	Selections []selection `json:"selections"`
}

type row struct {
	ID                       string  `json:"id"`
	Input                    string  `json:"input"`
	SourceKind               string  `json:"source_kind"`
	ExpectedNS               *string `json:"expected_ns"`
	Reject                   bool    `json:"reject"`
	OriginalFractionalOracle *int    `json:"original_fractional_ns,omitempty"`
}

type envelope struct {
	SchemaVersion int      `json:"schema_version"`
	GoVersion     string   `json:"go_version"`
	Sources       []source `json:"sources"`
	Rows          []row    `json:"rows"`
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func digest(b []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(b)) }

func load(path, hash string) ([]byte, *token.FileSet, *ast.File) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	must(err)
	if digest(b) != hash {
		panic("source hash mismatch: " + path)
	}
	fs := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fs, path, b, 0)
	must(err)
	return b, fs, f
}

func excerpt(name string, n ast.Node, b []byte, fs *token.FileSet) selection {
	start, end := fs.Position(n.Pos()), fs.Position(n.End())
	text := string(b[start.Offset:end.Offset]) + "\n"
	return selection{name, [2]int{start.Line, end.Line}, digest([]byte(text)), text}
}

func oracle(id, input, kind string, fractional *int) row {
	if len(input) > 128 {
		panic("input exceeds the 128-byte selection ceiling: " + id)
	}
	tm, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, input)
	r := row{ID: id, Input: input, SourceKind: kind, Reject: err != nil, OriginalFractionalOracle: fractional}
	if err == nil {
		// UnixNano would silently wrap outside int64. Unix seconds for the
		// selected four-digit calendar years fit int64; multiply using big.Int.
		ns := new(big.Int).Mul(big.NewInt(tm.Unix()), big.NewInt(1_000_000_000))
		ns.Add(ns, big.NewInt(int64(tm.Nanosecond())))
		value := ns.String()
		r.ExpectedNS = &value
		if fractional != nil && tm.Nanosecond() != *fractional {
			panic("original fractional oracle changed: " + id)
		}
	} else if fractional != nil {
		panic("original table row rejected: " + id)
	}
	return r
}

func main() {
	if runtime.Version() != "go1.27.3" || len(os.Args) != 3 {
		panic("requires Go 1.27.3 and arguments: format_test.go params.go")
	}
	const goHash = "f8646ea90208c0904b5988685c2d78a5f90535ef98a2b4dcd8d53fbb45f0d9a4"
	const lokiHash = "dc0de59305ac3be3577395fe984a37bd75bdd290a3a23e15c6d206139a928f6d"
	b, fs, f := load(os.Args[1], goHash)
	out := envelope{SchemaVersion: 1, GoVersion: "go1.27.3", Sources: []source{
		{Repository: "https://github.com/golang/go", Version: "go1.27.3", Path: "src/time/format_test.go", SHA256: goHash},
		{Repository: "https://github.com/grafana/loki", Revision: "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d", Path: "pkg/loghttp/params.go", SHA256: lokiHash},
	}}
	for _, decl := range f.Decls {
		switch d := decl.(type) {
		case *ast.GenDecl:
			for _, spec := range d.Specs {
				v, ok := spec.(*ast.ValueSpec)
				if !ok || len(v.Names) != 1 || v.Names[0].Name != "longFractionalDigitsTests" {
					continue
				}
				out.Sources[0].Selections = append(out.Sources[0].Selections, excerpt(v.Names[0].Name, d, b, fs))
				for i, item := range v.Values[0].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
					values := item.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts
					input, err := strconv.Unquote(values[0].(*ast.BasicLit).Value)
					must(err)
					fractional, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.ReplaceAll(values[1].(*ast.BasicLit).Value, "_", ""))
					must(err)
					out.Rows = append(out.Rows, oracle(fmt.Sprintf("go-long-fraction-%02d", i+1), input, "upstream_table", &fractional))
				}
			}
		case *ast.FuncDecl:
			if d.Name.Name == "TestParseFractionalSecondsLongerThanNineDigits" {
				out.Sources[0].Selections = append(out.Sources[0].Selections, excerpt(d.Name.Name, d, b, fs))
			}
		}
	}
	if len(out.Rows) != 16 || len(out.Sources[0].Selections) != 2 {
		panic("incomplete upstream selection")
	}
	b, fs, f = load(os.Args[2], lokiHash)
	for _, decl := range f.Decls {
		if d, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok && d.Name.Name == "parseTimestamp" {
			out.Sources[1].Selections = append(out.Sources[1].Selections, excerpt(d.Name.Name, d, b, fs))
		}
	}
	if len(out.Sources[1].Selections) != 1 {
		panic("missing Loki delegation source")
	}
	controls := []struct{ id, input string }{
		{"hour-single-zero", "1970-01-01T0:00:00Z"},
		{"hour-single-one", "1970-01-01T1:00:00Z"},
		{"hour-padded-one", "1970-01-01T01:00:00Z"},
		{"hour-23", "1970-01-01T23:00:00Z"},
		{"hour-24", "1970-01-01T24:00:00Z"},
		{"hour-three-digits", "1970-01-01T001:00:00Z"},
		{"minute-single", "1970-01-01T01:0:00Z"},
		{"second-single", "1970-01-01T01:00:0Z"},
		{"fraction-none", "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"fraction-dot-empty", "1970-01-01T00:00:00.Z"},
		{"fraction-comma-empty", "1970-01-01T00:00:00,Z"},
		{"fraction-dot-one", "1970-01-01T00:00:00.1Z"},
		{"fraction-comma-one", "1970-01-01T00:00:00,1Z"},
		{"fraction-dot-six", "1970-01-01T00:00:00.123456Z"},
		{"fraction-comma-six", "1970-01-01T00:00:00,123456Z"},
		{"fraction-dot-nine", "1970-01-01T00:00:00.123456789Z"},
		{"fraction-comma-nine", "1970-01-01T00:00:00,123456789Z"},
		{"fraction-dot-ten", "1970-01-01T00:00:00.1234567899Z"},
		{"fraction-comma-ten", "1970-01-01T00:00:00,1234567899Z"},
		{"fraction-dot-many", "1970-01-01T00:00:00.999999999999999999999999999999Z"},
		{"fraction-comma-many", "1970-01-01T00:00:00,000000000999999999999999999999Z"},
		{"fraction-mixed", "1970-01-01T00:00:00.1,2Z"},
		{"fraction-nondigit", "1970-01-01T00:00:00.aZ"},
		{"fraction-before-seconds", "1970-01-01T00:00.1Z"},
		{"zone-missing", "1970-01-01T00:00:00"},
		{"zone-name", "1970-01-01T00:00:00UTC"},
		{"zone-no-colon", "1970-01-01T00:00:00+0000"},
		{"zone-hour-single", "1970-01-01T00:00:00+0:00"},
		{"zone-minute-single", "1970-01-01T00:00:00+00:0"},
		{"pre-epoch-second", "1969-12-31T23:59:59Z"},
		{"pre-epoch-nanosecond", "1969-12-31T23:59:59.999999999Z"},
		{"pre-epoch-comma-long", "1969-12-31T23:59:59,9999999999Z"},
		{"pre-epoch-date", "1900-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"leap-valid", "2000-02-29T12:34:56Z"},
		{"leap-century-invalid", "1900-02-29T12:34:56Z"},
		{"leap-year-invalid", "2023-02-29T00:00:00Z"},
		{"day-zero", "2024-01-00T00:00:00Z"},
		{"day-april-31", "2024-04-31T00:00:00Z"},
		{"month-zero", "2024-00-01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"month-13", "2024-13-01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"leap-second", "2016-12-31T23:59:60Z"},
		{"minute-60", "1970-01-01T00:60:00Z"},
		{"year-zero", "0000-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"year-one", "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"year-9999", "9999-12-31T23:59:59.999999999Z"},
		{"year-five-digits", "10000-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"year-negative", "-0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"separator-space", "1970-01-01 00:00:00Z"},
		{"separator-lower-t", "1970-01-01t00:00:00Z"},
		{"separator-lower-z", "1970-01-01T00:00:00z"},
		{"separator-slash", "1970/01/01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"separator-time-dash", "1970-01-01T00-00-00Z"},
		{"month-single", "1970-1-01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"day-single", "1970-01-1T00:00:00Z"},
		{"trailing-space", "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z "},
		{"leading-space", " 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
		{"trailing-newline", "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z\n"},
		{"trailing-nul", "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z\x00"},
		{"trailing-data", "1970-01-01T00:00:00Zjunk"},
		{"int64-min", "1677-09-21T00:12:43.145224192Z"},
		{"int64-min-outside", "1677-09-21T00:12:43.145224191Z"},
		{"int64-min-inside", "1677-09-21T00:12:43.145224193Z"},
		{"int64-max", "2262-04-11T23:47:16.854775807Z"},
		{"int64-max-outside", "2262-04-11T23:47:16.854775808Z"},
		{"int64-max-inside", "2262-04-11T23:47:16.854775806Z"},
		{"int64-min-zone", "1677-09-21T01:12:43.145224192+01:00"},
		{"int64-max-zone", "2262-04-11T22:47:16.854775807-01:00"},
		{"int64-min-long-truncation", "1677-09-21T00:12:43.1452241929Z"},
		{"int64-max-long-truncation", "2262-04-11T23:47:16.8547758079Z"},
	}
	for _, c := range controls {
		out.Rows = append(out.Rows, oracle("control-"+c.id, c.input, "authored_control", nil))
	}
	for _, sign := range []string{"+", "-"} {
		for _, zone := range []string{"00:00", "01:30", "23:59", "24:00", "00:60", "24:60", "25:00", "00:61", "25:60", "24:61"} {
			id := "control-zone-" + map[string]string{"+": "plus", "-": "minus"}[sign] + "-" + strings.ReplaceAll(zone, ":", "-")
			out.Rows = append(out.Rows, oracle(id, "1970-01-01T00:00:00"+sign+zone, "authored_control", nil))
		}
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, r := range out.Rows {
		if seen[r.ID] {
			panic("duplicate ID: " + r.ID)
		}
		seen[r.ID] = true
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	must(enc.Encode(out))
}
